en: Well, for 900 pounds,
I'll give you info that's worth every penny.
There's a gambling den under the pub.
Head there first.
Say just two words to the dealer,
"Black Rose,"
and they'll let you in.
Go to the gambling den downstairs.
Then check out all sorts of things
with your own eyes.
Good luck to ya!
Don't forget: "Black Rose."
Your blood... I shall take it for my own.
Wh-who's there?!
What the hell are you doing?!!
From this day on, you shall work as my servant.
Gyaaahiiieeeeeee!!!!
Even your sort
will do well enough as a servant.
Say, there's a name all the town's whispering.
note: Must be followed by #270 (slice 003) as a full sentence, e.g. 'Ever heard of Jack the Ripper?'

en: Welcome to my secret hideout
No. 1!
Or that's the kinda place it is, anyway.
Do you really know that Jack?
(This seems a little fishy...)
I'll bring you as much money as it takes.
Your blood... I'll be taking it.
Starting today, I'd like you to
help me with my work, please.
Someone like you, I think,
spending your time helping me
might do everyone more good.
Bestow your wisdom upon me, my lord...
Now, command me as you will...
My body aches, and I can't fathom why.
I can hardly have fallen out of bed...
Pray, give me your orders...
note: Follows '{NAME}, my master...' (#0), so it starts a sentence.

en: What on earth has happened to me...?
My weariness grows worse each time I sleep...
Ah, who might you be?
Forgive me, I was reading...
No, think nothing of it.
I've just moved here and came to say hello.

note: After the name: 'I am {NAME}.', 'My name is {NAME}.', '{NAME}.' in reply to 'who are you?'.

en: Nice to meet you.
How courteous. I'm Matthew, a teacher.
I raise my pupils to be fine modern men.
I take pride in my work.
(To me, humans are
all the same, though.)
Don't you have work to go to?
Good day to you, er...
Ah, forgive me. I was lost in thought...
Sorry, I've disturbed you.
I'll take my leave.
! What a pleasant surprise.
note: After the name: '{NAME}! What a pleasant surprise.'

en: I'm glad to see you looking well.
My days have been good too, thank you.
Pondering learning, guiding pupils to truth.
It's a good life.
Good evening.
Hm? Oh, ah... Good evening.
Pardon me, I was reading a book...
Ah, my apologies.
So, what is it you're reading?
A specialist text. A book on science.
An age of technical progress, ideal for study!
I begrudge even the time spent walking.
...You don't seem very interested.
I'm in a hurry, so I'll be going.
Ah, good evening... Who might you be again?
Good evening... Er, Mister...?
Pardon me, I was absorbed in my reading...
No, really, my apologies. Let's talk another time.
Mutter, mutter... Science truly is wonderful.
He could just read at home at his leisure...
Ah,
! Good evening.
note: After the name, as #69 ('!') with the next row starting a sentence.

en: I've made sure to remember your name.
<Not reading a book today?>
